name: inheritance3.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))

(define-sort Set (T) (Array T Bool))

; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (bobj Ref)(theSum Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((A (mk-A (x Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((B (mk-B (x Int)(y Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-A (sel-A A))
  (lift-B (sel-B B))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-A ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-A (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-A ((this Ref)) A
  (sel-A (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-B ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-B (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-B ((this Ref)) B
  (sel-B (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-A ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-A this)
    (deref-is-B this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-B ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-B this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.bobj: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!bobj ((this Ref)) Ref
  (bobj (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.theSum: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!theSum ((this Ref)) Int
  (theSum (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ------------------------
;   Getters for class A:
; ------------------------

; --- getters for A.x: ---

(define-fun A.x ((this Ref)) Int
  (ite (deref-is-A this) (x (deref-A this))
  (x (deref-B this)))
)

(define-fun A!x ((this Ref)) Int
  (x (deref-A this))
)

; ------------------------
;   Getters for class B:
; ------------------------

; --- getters for B.x: ---

(define-fun B.x ((this Ref)) Int
  (x (deref-B this))
)

(define-fun B!x ((this Ref)) Int
  (x (deref-B this))
)

; --- getters for B.y: ---

(define-fun B.y ((this Ref)) Int
  (y (deref-B this))
)

(define-fun B!y ((this Ref)) Int
  (y (deref-B this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ------------------------
;   Methods for class A:
; ------------------------

(define-fun A.get ((this Ref)) Int
  (A.x this)
)

(define-fun A!get ((this Ref)) Int
  (A!x this)
)

; ------------------------
;   Methods for class B:
; ------------------------

(define-fun B.get ((this Ref)) Int
  (B.x this)
)

(define-fun B!get ((this Ref)) Int
  (B!x this)
)

(define-fun B.sum ((this Ref)(k Int)) Int
  (+ (+ (B.get this ) (B.y this)) k)
)

(define-fun B!sum ((this Ref)(k Int)) Int
  (+ (+ (B!get this ) (B!y this)) k)
)

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!theSum this) (B.sum (TopLevelDeclarations!bobj this) (B.get (TopLevelDeclarations!bobj this) )))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert57))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-B (TopLevelDeclarations!bobj this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 0) :named _xkassert58))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!theSum this) 9)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 0) :named _xkassert59))



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class A:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-A A)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun A.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (A!x this) 2)
)

(assert (! (A.inv1 1) :named _xkassert60))



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class B:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-2-B B)
(declare-const const-3-B B)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun B.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (B!x this) 2)
)

(assert (! (B.inv1 2) :named _xkassert61))
(assert (! (B.inv1 3) :named _xkassert62))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun B.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (B!y this) 5)
)

(assert (! (B.inv2 2) :named _xkassert63))
(assert (! (B.inv2 3) :named _xkassert64))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-A const-1-A))
        2 (lift-B const-2-B))
        3 (lift-B const-3-B))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-1-A () A
  (mk-A 2))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 2 9))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (_ as-array k!4))
(define-fun const-2-B () B
  (mk-B 2 5))
(define-fun const-3-B () B
  (mk-B 2 5))
(define-fun k!3 ((x!1 Int)) Any
  (ite (= x!1 2) (lift-B (mk-B 2 5))
  (ite (= x!1 1) (lift-A (mk-A 2))
  (ite (= x!1 0) (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 2 9))
    null))))
(define-fun k!0 ((x!1 Int)) Any
  null)
(define-fun k!4 ((x!1 Int)) Any
  (ite (= x!1 2) (lift-B (mk-B 2 5))
  (ite (= x!1 3) (lift-B (mk-B 2 5))
  (ite (= x!1 1) (lift-A (mk-A 2))
  (ite (= x!1 0) (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 2 9))
    null)))))
(define-fun k!1 ((x!1 Int)) Any
  (ite (= x!1 0) (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 2 9))
    null))
(define-fun k!2 ((x!1 Int)) Any
  (ite (= x!1 1) (lift-A (mk-A 2))
  (ite (= x!1 0) (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 2 9))
    null)))
